review: The oat milk latte was perfect and the barista remembered my name from last week. Cozy seats, quick service even during the morning rush - this is my new favorite spot in the neighborhood.
Cold coffee, a 25 minute wait, and nobody even looked up when I tried to ask about my order. Really disappointing for the price - I won't be back.
Beautiful room and a stunning ocean view, and the bed was incredibly comfortable. But check-in took forever, and the shower water pressure was weak both mornings.
